steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.

Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cheese in a large bowl. In another large bowl, beat together egg, milk, and oil. Stir the flour/cheese mixture into the egg mixture, stirring until just moistened. Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean, about 35 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Quick and Easy Cheese Bread
raw_recipe.description: This savory quick bread delivers a bounty of Cheddar. It’ll make a perfect accompaniment to almost any meal.
raw_recipe.name: Quick and Easy Cheese Bread

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.

Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cheese in a large bowl. In another large bowl, beat together egg, milk, and oil. Stir the flour/cheese mixture into the egg mixture, stirring until just moistened. Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean, about 35 minutes.

review.reviewBody: I thought this was a great simple quick bread recipe. I followed other reviewers suggestions and used 1 cup of milk and 1 1/2 cups of cheese. I also added a package of italian dressing mix and decreased the salt to about 1/4 teaspoon. I thought it was great. My bread didn't crumble like other reviews had trouble with. The crust was crisp, but the bread was soft and fluffy. I will keep this recipe on hand the next time I was some fresh bread in a hurry.

Tried this recipie with jambalaya and found the sweetness of the dough was the perfect compliment to the savory dish. I did use the extra milk and extra cheese.... extra old cheddar inside and old cheddar and parmesan on top. But I decided the sweetness of the dough might make a great loaf too. I skipped the cheese and folded 2 medium sized diced apples coated in white and brown sugar and cinnamon into the dough just before it went in the pan. Then I cut 1 tbsp butter into 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tbsp of flour. Spread over top as a crumble and bake. It took extra time, around 45 minutes. Just keep.poking it! The result was absolutely amazing! Delicious moist apple bread. Great for.french toast.too!
I added an extra 1/2 cup of cheese inside the bread and an extra 1/2 cup on top during the last 10 min. Less sugar and more milk. It rose beautifully and had a nice golden color!

This quick cheese bread was really good. Mine was not crumbly at all. Great crust and soft inside. I used 1 1/2 cups cheese and a cup of milk as others mentioned. Pinch of salt and about teaspoon of sugar. To the cheddar I added a small amount of grated Romano cheese. Nice easy substitute for Easter Roman cheese bread.

I added a few ingredients and changed the amount of vegetable oil (1/8 C) and cut in approx. 2/3 Cup of butter. I also added 1/4 C chopped red and orange sweet peppers and 2 scallions chopped fine. I also used 1 1/2 C of shredded cheese. It is delicious,

Great basic savory quick bread recipe. I made 3/4 cup of the flour whole wheat, 1cup milk, and about 1-1/2 cups shredded mild cheddar. I also reduced the sugar to 1 T, and added about 1/8 t cayenne and 1/4 t garlic powder. Moist on the inside, crumbly on the outside. Yum!

This recipe is really good, if:

1. reduce sugar to 1 tbsp
2. add sauted 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, and 1 jalapeno
3. add fresh rosemary
4. add 1/2 cup cheese after 20 min.
5. take out after 30 min.

Just made this for dinner tonight. I followed the other reviewer's advice and raised the milk to 1 cup. I also used white whole wheat flour and cooked it in a muffin tin instead of loaf form, so the cooking time was a few minutes less. Everyone loved these and I will make again! Thanks :)

Delicious. I changed it up a bit and used garlic cheddar cheese and used my muffin top pan and made individual rolls. Also, I made them gluten free as I have celiac disease. They were so good, I've got a second batch going now and will have to post as I used buttermilk in this batch rather than milk.

Delicious. I changed it up a bit and used garlic cheddar cheese and used my muffin top pan and made individual rolls. Also, I made them gluten free as I have celiac disease. They were so good, I've got a second batch going now and will have to post as I used buttermilk in this batch rather than milk.
I love this. Took many of the suggestions made by others — more cheese, less sugar, a touch of garlic salt. But I also added a teaspoon of “herbes de Provence”. which was wonderful.
I used a spicy ghost pepper cheese. It was fanatastic!

Love this recipe! I live at a higher altitude, so I cooked it for about 30 minutes. It is very fragile serving it hot, but I served a side a marinara with it and it’s great! I did also add a smidge of Italian seasoning on top before baking. Super quick and easy!

This was easy, with a few readily available ingredients at home, and tastes really good. I used whole wheat flour for a healthier option, and that might have taken away a bit, but I'm not blaming the recipe for it. It's probably better with white flour, but perfectly doable with whole wheat.
I love it. Don't change anything
I was nice and quick to make but thought it was too sweet and lacked flavour, next time I’m going to add bacon and onion
Despite doubling the cheese and adding some garlic powder, this bread still turned out to be a bit plain and strangely sweet.
I like the recipe but I added mushrooms a little bit of cayenne pepper
It came out nice but not much flavor. I would recommend adding some garlic powder, onion powder to this recipe.

This tastes great. I used my pancake mix in place of flour, sugar, and baking powder, as it was about to expire. My 5 years old daughter loves the cheese and her dad loves bread so this entire serving for 12 was enough just for the two of them. I guess I need to make some more ??
